notes.title: Update notes for 2.32
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A new update has gone live today (2.32) which updates the game engine and fixes three ending achievements that had stopped working. If you recently played the game and these achievements didn't unlock for you, please update and load the game. The missing achievements should unlock immediately! :)

Apologies for the inconvenience and thank you to those who alerted me to the problem. If anyone is still having issues, please contact me at [b]contact (at) kinmoku (dot) games[/b] and I will take a look.

Thanks again for supporting One Night Stand!

tags.bug: - fixes three ending achievements that had stopped working.

notes.title: Update notes for 2.31
notes.content:
Hello,

Update 2.31 contains a fix for Steam achievements. Please update your game for achievements to work correctly from now on.

tags.bug: - Update 2.31 contains a fix for Steam achievements.

notes.title: One Night Stand – Update 2.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a while! ːons_shewavesː

A small new update has just released for One Night Stand. It features:

[list]
[*]  A clearer credits page
[*]  Translation fixes
[*]  ...and a whole new look for Kinmoku (that's me!)
[/list]
Please update so you have the latest version of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26739532/7d0626f21497e218867a54fd623d889c101bfa1d.gif[/img]

Inspired by the early roots of visual novels – from PC-98 to Sega Saturn – the new splash artwork features Kinmoku in their studio. If you look closely you can see references to Kinmoku's games, and even their dog, Goro!

To learn more about the developer, please check out the new website at [url=https://www.kinmoku.games]www.kinmoku.games[/url]

tags.feature: ...and a whole new look for Kinmoku (that's me!)

notes.title: Update 2.252
notes.content:
Just a small update this time! An achievement bug stopping Chinese and German players from getting "Coincidence much?", "Sure, why not?" and "How unfortunate…" has been fixed.

Some spelling and formatting errors have also been improved.

Thanks again for playing!

tags.bug: - An achievement bug stopping Chinese and German players from getting "Coincidence much?", "Sure, why not?" and "How unfortunate…" has been fixed.

notes.title: Update 2.251
notes.content:
Good news for Chinese and German players!

The bug which was stopping Chinese players from finishing the ending "In a Twist" has been fixed. Small graphical improvements have been made to the Chinese and German versions as well.

Also, there has been an engine update. See https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/changelog.html for more information.

Thank you all for continuing to enjoy One Night Stand!

tags.bug: The bug which was stopping Chinese players from finishing the ending "In a Twist" has been fixed.

tags.feature: Small graphical improvements have been made to the Chinese and German versions as well.

notes.title: One Night Stand is now playable in brazilian portuguese and French!
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that One Night Stand is now playable in French and Brazilian Portuguese! Download the latest build and select French or Brazilian from the main menu to enable.

2.24 also fixes the following bugs: Crashes when replaying a reset game, main menu flickering, a typo when clicking on the notebook, and the True Friends replay not working correctly.

Thanks again for your continued support!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26739532/831084b04aa4b175dcf9c8bbdbc9c647209ef346.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26739532/0c066b527412a317c0fcb5e391355c6d7a672e9c.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the Steam Summer sales!
